records.rationale: The observation is factually true — the diff shows `create_table :topic_embeds, force: true` on a new migration — but it describes no incorrect behavior: on a fresh migration the table does not exist, so `force: true` is a no-op boilerplate, and 'it would drop the table if it already existed' is speculative for a brand-new migration. This is a pure style/preference nit with no decision-relevant consequence to the maintainer's review of this change (e.g., data loss or broken behavior is not introduced by this diff).

records.issue_text: lib/tasks/disqus.thor:117 — Removal of the `--category`/`-c` CLI option is a breaking change for existing script callers with no deprecation or replacement, since TopicEmbed.import_remote provides no way to set a category
records.rationale: The diff confirms the finding: disqus.thor removes `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` and the category_id lookup, replacing PostCreator-with-category with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and TopicEmbed.import_remote's signature (user, url, opts[:title]) offers no category parameter. This silently drops a documented CLI capability for existing callers, which is a real breaking behavior change introduced by this diff.
